issue_title: stream.dash: incorrect base_url (BaseURL) handling after fetching manifest
issue_body:

### Collaboration

- [x] [I will provide feedback should a pull request be opened with a fix for the problem](https://github.com/streamlink/streamlink/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-request-feedback)

### Streamlink version

7.0.0+31.gfac5d8f7

### Description

## The Issue

Hi! Recently I'm testing MPEG-DASH with streamlink. After encountering a bunch of HTTP 404 errors when downloading segments, I've started to read the code, and then fortunately I think I've found the solution.

My command lines:

```console
$ ffmpeg -i test.mkv -c copy -f dash test.mpd

$ ffprobe test.mkv

  built with gcc 13.2.0 (crosstool-NG 1.25.0.232_c175b21)
  configuration: ...
  ...
Input #0, matroska,webm, from 'test.mkv':
  Metadata:
    COMPATIBLE_BRANDS: isomiso2avc1mp41

```

## My Solution

https://github.com/streamlink/streamlink/blob/fac5d8f740952485ce2c094e2826ed358fbe90fd/src/streamlink/stream/dash/dash.py#L256-L260

```diff
-        urlp[2], _ = urlp[2].rsplit("/", 1)
+        urlp[2] = urlp[2].rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/"
```

And also add a correspoding test:

```Python
    def test_baseurl_urljoin(self):
        with xml("dash/test_baseurl_urljoin.mpd") as mpd_xml:
            mpd = MPD(mpd_xml, base_url="https://foo/bar", url="https://foo/bar/manifest.mpd")
        # ...                                           ^
        #                             No trailing slash |

        assert segment_urls == [
            [
                ("empty-baseurl", "absolute-segments", "https://foo/absolute/init_video_5000kbps.m4s"),
                ("empty-baseurl", "absolute-segments", "https://foo/absolute/media_video_5000kbps-1.m4s"),
            ],
            [
                ("empty-baseurl", "relative-segments", "https://foo/relative/init_video_5000kbps.m4s"),
                ("empty-baseurl", "relative-segments", "https://foo/relative/media_video_5000kbps-1.m4s"),

```

hints_text:
After doing bisect, I found this issue is introduced by #6328 (53ac068d1c1eeaf574f0cc3041824891a7c663d2). To make `urllib.parse.urljoin` work correctly, we need to provide a "correct" base URL. The correctness is, for example, if we treat the parent URL of MPD as `BaseURL`, we need to make it end with a slash. In https://github.com/streamlink/streamlink/issues/6327#issuecomment-2522739927, @bastimeyer said: > I have no idea why the following was ever implemented, because it seems totally wrong to me and a simple `urljoin(url, other)` would suffice: > ```py > if not parts[2].endswith("/"): > parts[2] += "/" > ``` > https://github.com/streamlink/streamlink/blame/7.0.0/src/streamlink/stream/dash/manifest.py#L398-L410 I guess the above lines may be related to the path processing we are talking here.
In addition, I've searched "BaseURL" in [DASH-IF-IOP-v4.3.pdf](https://dashif.org/docs/DASH-IF-IOP-v4.3.pdf) and didn't see any statement talking about the rule of the URL, so we can add the `base_url="https://foo/bar"` test to keep the maximum compatibility. Thanks for the bug report. The BaseURL merging/joining was just updated in #6328. Your DASH manifest however does not include any `BaseURL` nodes, so the "document" BaseURL depends on the input URL. The code you're referencing from `DASHStream.fetch_manifest()` is incorrect and also need to be updated. I forgot about that in #6328. I'll have a quick look later today.
